title: Three Palms Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Escape to our private Bungalow at Seagrove for a wonderful getaway. "Three Palms" is a charming cottage in a great community within walking distance to the beach. This bungalow sleeps up to 6 people, making it the perfect location for a family vacation.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. ▪️ Pet Friendly ▪️ Recently Renovated ▪️ Balcony overlooking pool - Watch your kids from your terrace! ▪️ Beach wagon, 2 beach chairs, umbrella and toys at the property ▪️ Golf cart charging stations ▪️ 2 adult sized beach cruiser bikes ▪️ Private grill (propane) ▪️ Short walk to the beach and community pool ▪️ Fully stocked kitchen complete with standard drip coffee maker ▪️ Smart TV's in each bedroom and living room ▪️ Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: → Pet fee of $150 → Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($100 fee applies at booking). HOME DETAILS: "Three Palms" is a charming bungalow in a great community within a 5-minute walk to the beach. This 2-bedroom 2.5 bathroom bungalow sleeps up to 6 people , making it the perfect location for a family vacation. Once inside this fully renovated bungalow, you will see the airy open living and dining spaces on the main level as well as the half bath and laundry closet. Upstairs are the 2 bedrooms complete with 2 ensuite bathrooms. The master and guest bedrooms share a shaded balcony with a sitting area overlooking the community pool and hot tub. Relax and enjoy the sleepy beach atmosphere, bright Bermuda-like colors, and swaying gulf breezes when you vacation on the beautiful beaches of South Walton. ACCOMMODATIONS (Sleeps 6): ✦First Floor: Large family room with flat screen TV, Fully stocked, beautifully renovated Kitchen with Dining for 6 plus 4 additional Bar Stools ✦Second Floor: Bedroom 1: King bed with private bath (shower only), flat screen TV, and balcony access overlooking the pool. Bedroom 2: Queen bed with TWIN bunks, flat screen TV and private bath (shower/tub combo), balcony access overlooking the pool. ✦The Bungalows is a quaint community located in Seagrove, close to several beach access locations, restaurants and shops! PET FRIENDLY! 1 Small non-shedding dog considered with non-refundable $150 pet fee. ✦2 BIKES!! ✦Must be 25 to rent ✦FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
